description: Get owner earnings and ROIC (return on invested capital) by fiscal year, oldest first: net income, depreciation and amortization, capital expenditures, owner earnings (net income + D&A - capex), an estimated maintenance versus growth capex split, and ROIC. Every reported figure is the latest filed value for exactly that fiscal year; ROIC is computed at the year's first filing date from the facts filed by then. The capex split is an estimate shown beside the headline figure, never inside it. A figure that is not on file or not provable is a dash, never an estimate. Owner earnings are computed for companies reporting in US dollars; a REIT is valued on FFO through GetValuationMultiples instead.

years.description: Fiscal years to return, keeping the newest (default 5, max 10).

name: GetOwnerEarnings
title: Owner Earnings and ROIC
